certificate.module_name: Cisco FTD FX-OS on 4K/9K Cryptographic Module
certificate.caveat: When operated in approved mode; The tamper evident seals and Physical Kit installed as indicated in the Security Policy; This module contains the embedded module [Cisco Firepower Threat Defense on 4K/9K Cryptographic Module] validated to FIPS 140-3 under Cert. #5456 operating in approved mode.
certificate.description: Cisco FTD FX-OS on 4K/9K Cryptographic Module is an integrated network security system providing enterprise-class firewall with a comprehensive range of next-generation network security services, intrusion prevention system (IPS), content security and secure unified communications, HTTPS/TLSv1.2, SSHv2, IPsec/IKEv2, SNMPv3 and Cryptographic Cipher Suite B.
